text: 6/20/2016		 Dear Brother [INSERT LAST NAME], We regret to inform you that a motion was made during the [INSERT CHAPTER NAME] Chapter's business meeting on [INSERT DATE] to consider you for CHAPTER SUSPENSION. The motion passed based on the following reason(s): [INSERT REASONS FOR DISCIPLINE HERE] (Examples: Failure to pay a chapter financial obligation Failure to meet minimum academic performance standards Persistent unexcused absences from chapter meetings or events Disregard for the Chapter’s welfare Other reasonable causes [EXPLAIN]) This action is in accordance with the National Constitution and Bylaws Title III, Article IX, Section 1: “Section 1. Reasons for discipline. For conduct which is harmful to the best interests or good name of the Fraternity, the chapter may expel any of its collegiate members from the Fraternity. If such conduct does not warrant expulsion, the chapter may place any of its collegiate members on suspension.” The chapter will take an official vote during the chapter meeting on [INSERT DATE] to decide if you will be placed on suspension. Three-fourths of members in good standing present and voting may place a member on suspension. Before this vote takes place you have the right to interview with the Chapter Executive Committee and Faculty Advisor. You have the right to waive this interview. This is in accordance with the National Constitution and Bylaws Title III, Article IX, Section 3. Should the chapter approve of the suspension, you may appeal to the National Executive Committee. Fraternally, [INSERT NAME][INSERT CHAPTER NAME] Secretary [INSERT NAME][INSERT CHAPTER NAME] President
